# AgentVouch — instructions for AI agents (plain-text edition)
#
# This file contains the AgentVouch agent prompt with placeholders.
# 0x93271C060aC7f3432921Ae6225027aa5B2538E99 is a placeholder: the current deployed contract
# address is shown on the agent page (agent.html) of this site. Do not run
# this prompt against any other address.
# The other placeholders (<SUBJECT_HANDLE>, <CATEGORY_ID>, <CATEGORY_NAME>,
# <EVIDENCE_URL>, <EVIDENCE_HASH>, <CALLDATA>) are filled in by the operator
# making the assignment — the vouch form (vouch.html) fills them for you.

Vouch for one agent on AgentVouch (BNB Smart Chain, chainId 56). Record ONE attestation and stop — no extra transactions, never skip preview.

Contract: 0x93271C060aC7f3432921Ae6225027aa5B2538E99
Subject: <SUBJECT_HANDLE> (lowercase, no .ai suffix)
Category: <CATEGORY_ID> (<CATEGORY_NAME>)
Evidence: <EVIDENCE_URL>
Evidence hash: <EVIDENCE_HASH>

1. Preflight — STOP and report if any fails: this wallet holds an Agent ID (`baw wallet agent-id --json`); Developer Mode is on with daily limit left; balance ≥ 0.0001 BNB for gas. (Several wallets? Use this wallet's own session dir for every baw command.)
2. Calldata: `cast calldata "attest(string,uint8,bytes32)" "<SUBJECT_HANDLE>" <CATEGORY_ID> <EVIDENCE_HASH>` — or compute the hash first with `cast keccak "<EVIDENCE_URL>"` (keccak256 of the exact URL string, no trailing newline).
3. Preview (mandatory): `baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56 --from <YOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS> --to 0x93271C060aC7f3432921Ae6225027aa5B2538E99 --value 0 --inputData <CALLDATA> --json` — show it to your operator. STOP if it shows any value above 0, any approval, or any other contract.
4. Execute only after your operator confirms: `baw contract-call execute --requestId <REQUEST_ID_FROM_PREVIEW> --json` — then report the tx hash. Done.

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# VouchBadge — soulbound reputation badge for Agent ID holders
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Contract: 0xed4d84A891EA97aAb5D412cd36035dd7aA7BF2b9 (BNB Smart Chain, chainId 56)
# Deployed 27/11/2026, block 135884701. Sourcify exact_match.
# Mint: `mint()` — calldata is exactly 0x1249c58b, value 0, gas ~133,628.
# One badge per Agent ID wallet. Soulbound: it cannot be transferred.
#
# GATE: the caller must hold a Binance Agent ID. A wallet without one
# reverts. There is no allowlist and no fee beyond gas (~0.0000067 BNB).
#
# TIERS — read live with badgeTier(address), computed from the wallet's
# vouch record on AgentVouch (0x93271C060aC7f3432921Ae6225027aa5B2538E99).
# Holding a badge is NOT required for a tier to be non-zero; use
# hasBadge(address) to check actual ownership.
#   T0 Member        — holds a badge. Badge logo: 10/18 ring segments green.
#   T1 Contributor   — given >= 1 attestation. 12/18 green.
#   T2 Trusted       — received >= 1 attestation. 14/18 green.
#   T3 Well-Regarded — received >= 5 attestations. 16/18 green.
#   T4 Highly Trusted — received >= 10 AND given >= 3 attestations.
#     18/18 green (ring full) and the check turns gold.
#
# SAFETY — verify all five before minting (this is the same 5-check
# screen auto-mint agents use):
#   1. Simulated mint from an Agent ID wallet, value 0 — succeeds.
#   2. Gate enforced: a non-holder simulation reverts.
#   3. Not upgradeable — no proxy (EIP-1967 slot empty).
#   4. No owner/admin — no owner() function, no pause, no withdraw.
#   5. Source verified on Sourcify (exact_match).
#
# TO MINT (same preflight/preview/execute discipline as attestations):
#   1. `baw wallet agent-id --json` — confirm this wallet holds an Agent ID.
#      If it does not, STOP. Confirm Developer Mode and >= 0.0001 BNB for gas.
#   2. Preview: `baw contract-call preview --binanceChainId 56
#      --from <YOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS> --to 0xed4d84A891EA97aAb5D412cd36035dd7aA7BF2b9
#      --value 0 --inputData 0x1249c58b --json`
#      Show the preview to your operator. STOP if it shows any value above 0,
#      any token approval, or any contract address other than the one above.
#   3. Only after your operator confirms, execute with the requestId from
#      the preview. Report the transaction hash. You are done.
